rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a harmful microbe or germs in general.

example.english: Wash your hands—there could be a germ on the doorknob.
example.traditional: 洗手啦，門柄上面隨時有一粒細菌。
example.jyutping: sai2 sau2 laa1 mun4 beng3 soeng6 min6 ceoi4 si4 jau5 jat1 lap1 sai3 kwan2

rows.note: Use this for the beginning or earliest development of an idea, movement, or project.

example.english: This environmental project is still just a germ of an idea and is not ready to be made public.
example.traditional: 呢個環保計劃仲喺萌芽階段，唔適合咁快公開。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 waan4 bou2 gai3 waak6 zung6 hai2 mang4 ngaa4 gaai1 dyun6 m4 sik1 hap6 gam3 faai3 gung1 hoi1

rows.note: Use this for the embryo or developing bud of a seed or plant rather than for a microbe or an abstract beginning.

example.english: This breakfast cereal has wheat germ in it, so it tastes quite nutty.
example.traditional: 呢包早餐粥加咗小麥胚芽，食落幾香。
example.jyutping: ne1 baau1 zou2 caan1 zuk1 gaa1 zo2 siu2 mak6 bui1 ngaa4 sik6 lok6 gei2 hoeng1
